buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses IMPORTANT : * Since the supply of gases necessitates frequent transport of empty and filled cylinders between VSSC & s upplier location, vendors having Manufacturing/Filling/Distribution units in Trivandrum, Kerala onl y shall participate in the bid. (You are requested to attach documentary proof for the same along with the bid. Bids without documentary proof will be rejected at the time of Bid evaluation). * You shall upload the unit cost of Addon(s) along with the price bid . * The Price Quoted shall be firm and fixed during the entire currency of the contract. Ultra-High Pure Nitrogen Gas(1250 Cu m) Quantity : 1250 m3 Purity : 99.9997 % min Grade : 5.5 Gas cylinders will be accepted based on the COP (Certificate of Purity) for pure gas which must be submitted along with each supply. Cylinders without COP will be REJECTED. As a statutory mandat e cylinder shall be hydro tested. (Hydro test date shall be punched on the shoulder of the cylinder) . A valid Certificate of Hydro test or a certified copy shall be submitted for each cylinder, for record s and cross verification. If valve guard or valve cap is not in place, the cylinder will be REJECTED. P rior to acceptance of a gas cylinder inside VSSC, the cylinder shall be visually inspected for any lea k, corrosion, and crack in the valve or body of the cylinder. The weight of the gas cylinder or press ure of the cylinder shall be checked and recorded.

Delivery Schedule: The item shall be supplied in batches as per our requirement. Required quan tity shall be supplied within 2 weeks from the date of receipt of empty cylinders from VSSC. If you fails to supply the minimum Mandated Supply Liquidated Damages shall be evoked. The entire sup ply shall be completed preferably within a period of one year. After utilization of the Nitrogen gas during this period, if unutilized quantity is remaining in the PO, the validity of the purchase order s hall be extendable for one more year in the same rates, terms & conditions at the mutual consent of both the parties. GENERAL CONDITIONS:- The gas should be supplied in VSSC Cylinders as and when the requirement in staggere d manner as per the intimation from the Sr. Purchase & Stores Officer, PCM/STS STORE S, VSSC, Trivandrum – 695 022 All cylinders should be of uniform purity, material of construction, color code, valve outlet, pressur e, valve material and screw thread outlet. Any variation from the above- mentioned specifications shall result in rejection of the consignment. Details of valves (As per IS 3224:2002, page-16-17) The cylinders should be painted as specified under Gas Cylinder Rules 2004 If any of the above-mentioned conditions are not met, the whole consignment shall be rejected. Cylinder numbers should be clearly marked, preferably by paint, on all cylinders. It should be ensured that the cylinders are provided with protective caps. You shall provide Test Certificate for purity level, preparation tolerance and certification of accurac y, stability, pressure and quantity against each lot/or each cylinder whichever is applicable. If a ba tch certificate is submitted, the numbers of cylinders per batch with the serial number of the cylin ders are to be mentioned clearly. You shall mention the test methodology adopted to ascertain the purity of the gases. At least 50% of the cylinders should be tested for impurity levels after bottling and a batch test ce rtificate mentioning the cylinders (with cylinder identification number) tested should be produced along with the supply. All the cylinders should possess residual pressure valves set to a defined pr essure to avoid back-filling of the cylinders. You shall produce a Certificate declaring that you are the producer of the gas and that the cylinde rs are being filled at your own facility. You should have a GC Monitoring of the Impurity Levels in the Cylinder Filling Lines. You shall be re sponsible for all the regulatory record keeping requirements associated the use of licenses and lic ense exemptions etc All gas cylinders before filling shall be thoroughly cleaned and subjected to visual inspection of all surfaces including the bottom side to detect the damages, such as: Dents Cuts, Gouges and Digs Dents & Cuts Dents & Line marks Bulges

Stab marks Fusion marks & Fire damage Corrosion or Pitting Neck defects etc. General Distortion Cylinder Service Charges: - Replacement cost/Service charges of our cylinders at the following rates are applicable extra. GST extra as applicable are also payable for the replacement of spares/ servicing. a. Replacement of damaged valve guard/cap : Rs. each b. Replacement cost of Valve : Rs. each c. Replacement of damaged spindle : Rs each d. Replacement of damaged gland nut : Rs each e. Drilling out broken spindle or valve : Rs each f. Hydraulic Testing charges per cylinder : Rs each g. Painting charges : Rs cylinder h. PSE washing (applies only damaged valve replacement) : : Rs each i. Purging charges valve Replacement/Hydraulic Testing) : Rs each * (In case of any loss/damage beyond repair of our cylinder or not returned to you within two mon ths from the date of supply. Replacement cost (Rupees Eighteen Thousand only) plus applicable ta x shall be paid extra per cylinder). Transportation of Cylinders:- Transportation of empty cylinders to your site and collection of fil led cylinders shall be arranged by VSSC. Unloading of the empty cylinders and loading of filled cyli nders at your site shall be arranged by you. General Certification of compliance with the above clauses shall be provided with every supply. Liquidated Damages: The delivery period quoted by you and stipulated in the Purchase Order s hall be deemed to be the essence of the order and delivery must be completed not later than the d ate specified therein as otherwise VSSC shall have the right to recover a sum @ 0.5% of the order value per week or 0.5% of the value of the stores for which the delivery is delayed for each week o f delay, as the case may be, subject to a maximum of 10% of the order value. * Payment Term: Pro-Rata payment within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of each batch of ga s on production of bill. Payment shall be made on actual quantity of gas supplied. All oth er charges like replacement/service tax of spare parts and Addon(s) etc. if any shall be done o nce in three months only. Loading and Unloading:- We shall arrange loading/unloading of cylinders at VSSC. You shall arr ange the loading/unloading of cylinders at your site.

GST Concession: For Sellers inside Kerala, VSSC is eligible for concessional rate of GST as per Ministry of Finance, Dept. of Revenue Notification No. 09/2025 Central Tax (Rate) Schedule-I; Sl. No. 462 dated 17.09 5 / 8 .2025 and Government of Kerala, Department of Taxes Notification No. 147/2025/TD, Schedule-I; Sl. No. 4 62 dated 17.09.2025. Applicable rate is 5%.Necessary CGST/SGST concession certificate attached..
